description: This source file defines a class SearchSource responsible for producing search result streams within a distributed IoT framework. It manages querying, retrieving, and streaming JSON objects representing things, with support for resumption, error handling, and filtering.

classes.name: SearchSource
classes.description: A class responsible for creating streams of search results for querying IoT things, supporting features like pagination, filtering, and error recovery within an asynchronous, distributed environment.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Creates a stream of JSON search results, configured via a Consumer for resume source settings.

methods.name: startAsPair
methods.description: Creates a stream of search result pairs with IDs, supporting resume capabilities with custom configuration.

methods.name: mapError
methods.description: Handles errors in the stream, determining whether they are recoverable or should terminate with an exception.

methods.name: resume
methods.description: Resumes the search stream from the last known thing ID, retrieving additional elements.

methods.name: nextSeed
methods.description: Determines the next seed (last ID) for pagination based on retrieved elements.

methods.name: streamThingsFrom
methods.description: Retrieves the initial stream of things starting from a given ID or initial stream configuration.

methods.name: retrieveSortValues
methods.description: Fetches sort key values for a specified thing ID.

methods.name: retrieveThingForElement
methods.description: Retrieves a detailed JSON object for a given thing ID, handling exceptions for inaccessible or out-of-sync things.

methods.name: retrieveThing
methods.description: Performs a request to fetch a thing's details, returning an Akka Source of the JSON object.

methods.name: getDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns the Ditto headers used for search requests.

methods.name: expectMsgClass
methods.description: Creates an Akka Flow that filters incoming elements, expecting a specific message class.
